## Analysis
- **Role:** Thin feature-local wrapper (`AuthoringMessageBox`, `authoring-message-box.tsx:12`) that delegates entirely to the shared design-system `MessageBox`; it renders one blocking message on an explicit operator action and holds no state/logic.
- **Props:** `open`, `title`, `text`, `closeLabel`, `onClose` (callback), optional `testId` — all passed through unchanged; type is inline, no exported prop contract.
- **Coupling:** Imports `MessageBox` from `../../../design-system` (relative path); introduces no transport/auth/CQRS dependency, so no write-path or authz boundary is touched at this layer.
- **RTL/a11y:** No `dir`, `lang`, ARIA or focus-management logic here — semantics inherit from `MessageBox`; close control relies on `closeLabel` for accessible naming, so label localization must be supplied by the caller.
- **Boundary note:** Owning contract is the design-system `MessageBox`; this file is a pass-through alias (TB-263) with no independently verifiable behavior of its own.
- **OpenSpec:** No OpenSpec change loaded in this pass; no REQ IDs asserted.
